payload.title: Specialists require stronger evidence than global models
payload.decision: A regime-specialized coefficient expert may be tested only after E011 verification and may be promoted only when legal cross-fitted routing, adequate regime support, bounded action, exact fallback identity, complete-system gain, subgroup stability, catastrophe controls, and negative controls all pass. Uncertain or unsupported regimes must return the exact strongest verified global path.
payload.rationale: The BirdCLEF+ 2026 winner used specialists as masked components inside a diverse ensemble with complementary validation, controlled pseudo-labeling, and separately tuned pipelines. ROGII's prior routers repeatedly converted shared bias into confident but unstable action, so specialization has a higher burden than one global model.
payload.revisit_trigger: Only a preregistered specialist experiment with sufficient samples and independently reproduced gains across every frozen ROGII gate may revise this rule.
